title: HOKA Golden Ticket Races — Western States Endurance Run
claims: For the 2027 Western States, six races form the HOKA Golden Ticket series: three award two men's and two women's places, and three award three men's and three women's places.
Black Canyon 100K on 13 February 2027 is one of the three top-three races, with three automatic men's and three automatic women's places.
At the top-three races, the automatic bid slides to third, fourth and subsequently down to seventh place if needed.
Golden Ticket winners must meet Western States' male or female eligibility requirements; nonbinary runners must designate the male or female category in which they compete before the race.

Winners have two weeks from the qualifying race to decide and register; withdrawals before 1 May roll to the next runner in that race, no further than fifth or seventh, while withdrawals after 1 May go to the general wait list.
